Metadata.Title: Bruno Furtado — Frontend Engineer
Metadata.Description: Frontend Engineer with 6+ years of experience in React, Next.js, TypeScript and Svelte. Working on web applications, Design Systems and frontend architecture.

About.Title: About
About.CardDescription1: Building and evolving real web applications, from scratch and inside existing codebases.
About.CardDescription2: Component architecture, visual consistency and evolving UI libraries used in production.
About.CardDescription3: Web Vitals, accessibility and technical SEO best practices applied day to day.
About.Description: I've been working in frontend since 2019, across corporate platforms, conversion-focused products and, more recently, AI-driven SaaS applications. I have strong experience with React and Next.js, and today I also work with Svelte and SvelteKit as part of my regular stack — not as something I'm just exploring. Much of my recent work is tied to Design Systems: evolving component libraries, keeping consistency across teams, and balancing architecture decisions with the actual user experience. I like stepping into existing codebases, understanding what's already there, and evolving the product without breaking what works.

Experiences.Title: Begen
Experiences.Description: Building web applications in SvelteKit for AI-powered SaaS products, focused on maintainable code and evolving a Design System in production.
Responsibilities: Evolving the internal Design System (OCC): migrating and standardizing components to improve visual consistency and reduce maintenance effort across teams.
Building the Media Plan system for digital media — CRUDs, complex forms, validation, polling and async flows integrated with REST APIs.
Creating reusable components and refactoring legacy code to improve frontend architecture quality.
Managing state with Svelte 5 (runes) and integrating with REST APIs.
Working directly with Product Designers, Backend and QA to define flows and resolve complex bugs.
Code review and adoption of best practices to sustain performance and consistency across the product.

Experiences.Title: H&W Publishing
Experiences.Description: Building and maintaining web applications in Next.js, React and TypeScript, focused on performance, technical SEO and conversion.
Responsibilities: Built and maintained applications in Next.js, React and TypeScript, focused on componentization and code reuse.
Optimized performance and Core Web Vitals, keeping Lighthouse scores above 80 in performance, accessibility and SEO.
Implemented on-page technical SEO and accessibility best practices.
Built responsive, high-converting interfaces, translating business requirements into products that stayed consistent across devices.
Applied A/B testing and CRO to inform data-driven UX decisions.

Experiences.Title: Freelancer
Experiences.Description: Responsible for the full lifecycle of web projects for clients across different industries, from architecture through deployment and maintenance.
Responsibilities: Responsible for the complete project cycle — requirements, architecture, development, deployment and maintenance — using React, Next.js and TypeScript.
Delivered 20+ projects across different industries (education, crypto and institutional), adapting architecture and stack to each business context.
Built a platform with a members area and dashboard for content management, integrating the frontend with REST APIs and authentication flows.
Focused on performance, responsiveness and SEO to maximize conversion and reach for delivered products.

Experiences.Title: Lumis
Experiences.Description: Built responsive, accessible interfaces for a corporate DXP platform, progressing from intern to full-time throughout the role.
Responsibilities: Built responsive and accessible interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, SASS and JavaScript on a corporate DXP platform.
Created and maintained a library of reusable components, speeding up new demands and standardizing visual identity.
Implemented on-page SEO and WCAG accessibility compliance, improving indexing and organic reach.
Collaborated with multidisciplinary teams translating UX/UI designs into user-centered products, including HubSpot CRM integration for lead capture.

Feedbacks.Name: Anderson Nascimento
Feedbacks.Text: Dear Bruno, thank you so much for developing my company's website. It is undoubtedly another dream come true for all of us. The website has been a success and extremely valuable.

Feedbacks.Name: Rodrigo Marques
Feedbacks.Text: Bruno is a great professional and managed to make my dream and goal come true for years! We talked, and he quickly understood the demand and what I needed. He got it right the first time and delivered the website without having to make any changes. It was exactly what I needed and wanted! Thank you Bruno for making my dream come true! We are in this together!

Feedbacks.Name: Thayane Fabiano
Feedbacks.Text: Working with Bruno at Lumis helped me a lot to understand more about development and become a better designer. His willingness to learn, collaborate, and dedication to delivering the best possible result left an excellent impression on me.

Feedbacks.Name: Luis Fernando
Feedbacks.Text: It is the fulfillment of a long-time wish; Bruno helped us understand the process between imagining and making it happen, and from there, it's all history. I'm very happy with the result!

Feedbacks.Name: Bruna Gomes
Feedbacks.Text: Bruno is a very dedicated and helpful professional. We worked together on several projects, where he demonstrated a lot of efficiency and agility, always delivering great work.

Feedbacks.Name: Daniel Clemente
Feedbacks.Text: I had the pleasure of working with Bruno when he was part of the Marketing team at Lumis. Bruno was always very helpful and showed mastery over what he did and said. With him, I was able to better understand development and how our area worked together.
